<function name="UserID" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the player's user ID. This number will always be unique, but will reset if the player reconnects. (Always increments for each connecting player)

You can use <page>Global.Player</page> global function to get a player by their user ID.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The player's user ID</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
